resolution_summary: Rolled back the application, applied and verified the missing migration, then redeployed and checked affected queries.

title: Missing database index slows orders-api lookups
description: Request latency rose alongside database CPU and rows scanned per query. A frequently used filter column had no supporting index, causing full table scans.
resolution_summary: Added an index matching the lookup filter, verified the query plan used it, and confirmed latency and database CPU recovered.

title: Database connection exhaustion causes inventory-api failures
description: Requests failed with connection acquisition timeouts during a traffic spike. Connections were not released after exceptions in request handlers.
resolution_summary: Fixed connection cleanup in the exception handler, restarted affected instances, and verified pool usage recovered.

title: Incorrect database hostname breaks orders-api readiness
description: All newly deployed instances failed readiness checks. The database hostname in the new configuration was incorrect.
resolution_summary: Restored the correct database hostname and redeployed. Readiness checks and database connectivity passed.

title: Expired client certificate blocks auth-service requests
description: Service-to-service requests failed with certificate-expired errors. The client certificate had not been renewed before expiry.
resolution_summary: Renewed the client certificate, reloaded the service, and verified successful TLS authentication.

title: Queue backlog grows while notifications-worker workers are saturated
description: Queued jobs were delayed while worker CPU usage stayed near capacity. The consumer replica count was too low for the incoming message rate.
resolution_summary: Increased consumer replicas within downstream capacity, drained the queue, and configured scaling on queue age.

title: Stale resolver configuration causes DNS errors in payments-api
description: DNS queries timed out even though target services were healthy. The resolver configuration still referenced a DNS server removed during maintenance.
resolution_summary: Removed the retired DNS server from resolver configuration, reloaded affected instances, and verified repeated name lookups.

title: Payment provider connections time out in billing-api
description: Payment authorization attempts timed out before a connection was established. An egress firewall rule blocked the payment provider's documented address range.
resolution_summary: Restored the payment provider egress allowlist and verified connectivity. Reconciled payment statuses before retrying unresolved authorizations.

title: Unrotated logs fill the audit-service data volume
description: Disk utilization reached capacity and writes to the local volume failed. Log rotation was disabled, allowing local application logs to fill the volume.
resolution_summary: Archived and removed expired application logs, restored log rotation, and verified free space and successful writes.

title: Cache stampede overloads inventory-api database reads
description: Latency and database reads spiked when popular cache entries expired together. Popular cache entries used identical expiration times, triggering concurrent refreshes.
resolution_summary: Added expiration jitter and single-flight cache refresh, warmed popular entries, and verified database load stabilized.

title: Immediate retries amplify provider rate limits in sync-worker
description: Delivery delays increased as rejected requests were immediately resubmitted. The retry loop ignored Retry-After and had no backoff or concurrency cap.
resolution_summary: Honored Retry-After, added exponential backoff with jitter, capped concurrency, and verified delivery recovered within provider limits.

title: Unbounded export buffering causes analytics-worker restarts
description: Large export jobs were killed when memory usage exceeded the container limit. The export implementation buffered the entire result set in memory.
resolution_summary: Replaced full-result buffering with bounded streaming batches, reran failed exports, and verified memory stayed within limits.
